hypothesis: When Sudden Death (DEG-01) and star-6/star-7 enumeration (IMPL-03) are repaired, core-unrestricted-authority preserves equal seat balance and healthy game lengths.
independentVariable: Seat assignment (P1 vs P2) across a fully balanced 12x12 round-robin (every ordered pair played 4 times = 576 matches)
controlledVariables: identical hardware and node worker threads
counterfactualUsage: Selective counterfactual evaluation on close matches (score margin <= 3)
falsificationCriterion: Seat 1 win rate outside [0.45, 0.55] with p < 0.01 indicates genuine mechanical seat bias.
